references.context: Clear either drop-target bank to light three Snacks.
references.label: Scooby Snack drop banks
references.description: The two three-target banks on the left side light Snack inserts and expose the left VUK.

references.context: Start the chosen Case at the Mystery Machine.
references.label: Mystery Machine
references.description: The center-left physical lock starts Cases, collects unmaskings, and starts Mystery Machine Multiball.

references.context: Use the exposed VUK behind the drop banks for the left apron lock.
references.label: Left apron lock
references.description: The left VUK sends a qualified ball into the apron lock below the left flipper.

references.context: Shoot the upper playfield's middle orbit for the right apron lock.
references.label: Upper middle orbit
references.description: The center orbit on the upper playfield feeds the qualified right apron lock.
